mission.name: Imazu 01 -- head-on
mission.description: Canonical Imazu problem 1, reproduced from Sawada et al. (2021) Table 4 (J. Mar. Sci. Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 approaches head-on.
pass_criteria: Own-ship alters course to starboard (not port) for the head-on target(s).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
